decks.name: LeetCode #54 - Spiral Matrix
decks.description: Return all elements of a matrix in spiral order from outside to inside

cards.question: Spiral Matrix: Given an m x n matrix, return all elements of the matrix in spiral order. The spiral order means starting from the top-left, moving right across the top row, then down the right column, then left across the bottom row, then up the left column, and repeating inward.

solutions.name: Iteration (Optimal)
solutions.explanation: Use a directions array to cycle through right, down, left, up movements. Track remaining steps for horizontal and vertical movements separately. Use bitwise AND with 1 to alternate between horizontal and vertical step counts. Decrement step count after each direction and rotate to next direction.

Create directions list with tuples for right, down, left, up movements.
Create steps list with length of matrix at zero as horizontal steps and length of matrix minus one as vertical steps.
Initialize r to zero, c to negative one, d to zero.
Loop while steps at d bitwise AND one is non-zero.
Loop through range from zero to steps at d bitwise AND one.
Add directions at d at zero to r and assign back to r.
Add directions at d at one to c and assign back to c.
Append matrix at r c to res.
Decrement steps at d bitwise AND one by one.
Increment d by one.
Set d to d modulo four to cycle directions.
Return res.

Return [1,2,3,6,9,8,7,4,5].

solutions.explanation: Maintain four boundaries: left, right, top, bottom. Move in spiral order by traversing each boundary and shrinking the boundaries inward. After each pair of horizontal and vertical moves, check if boundaries still valid to handle edge cases.

Result [1,2,3,6,9,8,7,4,5].
